scope: One addition/deletion per attribute on two saved fixed bases per dataset; same three development splits and folds. Identical empty Yeast contexts duplicate semantically, not independent.
gain: Add: base_loss-candidate_loss; delete: candidate_loss-base_loss, positive means deletion harms prediction
association: Saved observed-minus-permutation mean W; descriptive correlation with additions
note: Positive addition gain increases acquisition cost and is not by itself a better reduct
